platform.scope: P24 records on authenticated unchanged runtime; every quantum-one Node checkpoint restored; native/Wasmtime compared at initial and every 64th checkpoint request

timings.protocol: Alternating independent processes; three warmups and nine samples; three windows extended to five if any ratio exceeds 1.05. Confirmation: median ratio >1.05 and at least four windows >1.05.
timings.scope: P24 selected shared schedules versus P23 control and structural baseline; rejected raw tiled candidates are a separate experiment

construction.scope: Closed semantic construction, sizing and destruction; original fixture construction excluded; 3 warmups and 9 samples in each of 3 alternating process windows

control.description: P23 production modules reconstructed in temporary control tree and matched byte-for-byte against recorded hashes

agent.scope: No supplied profile; no World runtime rebind
